info.faqA1p1: UZWORK is a global job marketplace connecting businesses, agencies and freelancers. Anyone can register and get to work.
info.faqA1p2: Businesses and teams use UZWORK to scale their capabilities, accelerate core projects, and access specialized expertise in AI, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Software Development and more.
info.faqA2p1: Clients search for freelancers, post projects, review proposals, and conduct interviews. Freelancers browse projects, submit proposals, or can be directly invited by clients.
info.faqA2p2: Freelancers and clients can collaborate on UZWORK's trusted platform with features like messaging, file sharing, time tracking, and secure payments.
info.faqA3p1: UZWORK is best used by companies of any size that need flexible and reliable freelancers. Individual entrepreneurs can use UZWORK for one-time projects.
info.faqA3p2: Freelancers use UZWORK to connect with businesses worldwide, find steady work, and advance their careers. It's a great platform for beginners starting in freelancing.
